name: Earth science: Seasonal Arctic sea-ice probabilities
description: Seasonal Arctic sea-ice probabilities with an explicit candidate interface, physical units, independent evaluator and source-traceable observations or numerical model.

sources.locator: Scientific process, benchmark motivation and evaluation assumptions.
Original source data/model; local candidate and evaluator are independently implemented.
Meier et al.2013, G02202 Version2 DOI10.7265/N55M63M1. Source monthly unedited CDR concentration, flags, projection and license; exact18files pinned locally.
Peng et al.2013 NOAA/NSIDC CDR algorithms, monthly concentrations, quality limitations and reproducibility.
Official NOAA NCEI v02r00 monthly files: July-December2013/2014 and January/March/June2014/2015. SHA256 pins in data/science/earth_expansion/seaice_sources.json.

requirements.datasets: 18 pinned official NOAA/NSIDC monthly satellite CDR files(~67MB), prepared E08 source bundle(~61MB), six forecasts on full native448x304 maps.

evaluation.benchmark: Earth science: Seasonal Arctic sea-ice probabilities
evaluation.paper_metric: Local protocol; see candidate contract and source adaptation notes

execution.interface: forecast_ice(history, past_climate_covariates, lead_months) -> (448,304) probabilities in[0,1] for monthly concentration>=0.15. Six actual NOAA/NSIDC G02202 v02r00 forecasts: July-December2013/2014 monthly histories predict next-year January/March/June at1/3/6-month leads. Native25km grid; area-weighted Brier over valid ocean north of60N using ellipsoidal cell areas, projected-km symmetric edge-distance diagnostic. Land/coast/pole-hole/missing flags excluded. Zeros outside supplied history_ocean_mask are placeholders. No future fields cross API. Historical NOAA observational adaptation, not original IceNet OSISAF data or leaderboard reproduction.

limitations: Historical NOAA/NSIDC G02202 v02r00 observational adaptation, not the original IceNet OSISAF dataset or full-paper score reproduction.
Six fixed public chronological development cases at1/3/6-month leads; independent generalization requires frozen candidates and unseen years.
Version2 is superseded and is not current operational data. Satellite retrieval and summer melt uncertainty remain; pole-hole, land/coastal and missing cells are excluded.
Only valid Arctic ocean north of60N is scored; historical invalid cells have explicit masked zero placeholders. Edge diagnostic uses projected, not great-circle, distances.

science_relevance.scientific_problem: Forecast seasonal Arctic sea-ice occurrence probabilities.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: Sea-ice forecasts support understanding and planning around changing Arctic marine conditions.

papers.title: Seasonal Arctic sea ice forecasting with probabilistic deep learning
papers.primary_goal: Predict Arctic sea-ice conditions months ahead with calibrated spatial probabilities.
papers.task_relation: The local task forecasts satellite-observed ice on six historical cases at one-, three- and six-month leads. It uses NOAA/NSIDC Version 2 CDR rather than the paper's original source and does not establish operational skill or generalization across unseen years.
